title_en: Write a letter to your friend about the importance of reading newspapers
title_bn: বন্ধুকে সংবাদপত্র পড়ার গুরুত্ব সম্পর্কে চিঠি
content:
Dear Friend,

I hope you are well. I am writing to you about about the importance of reading newspapers. This matter is useful and meaningful in student life. I wanted to share my experience and thoughts with you in a simple way. I hope the information will be helpful and encourage you to make good decisions.

No more today. Give my regards to your family.

Yours lovingly,
Your Friend

title_en: Application for setting up a college canteen
content:
To
The Principal
[College Name]

Subject: Setting up a college canteen.

Sir,
We, the students of your college, respectfully state that the requested facility is important for our academic and co-curricular development. At present, the existing arrangement is not sufficient for the needs of the students. We therefore request you to take necessary steps so that the facility can be arranged as soon as possible.

We shall remain grateful for your kind consideration.

Yours obediently,
The students
